shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets Plunge: Bitcoin fell below $69K; ETH under $2K, triggering over $1B in liquidations.
Spot ETF Outflows Continue: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $1.44B net outflows in five days.
Macro Headwinds Mount: Rising US inflation and Fed rate hike fears weigh on risk assets, including crypto.
Global Tensions Impact: Renewed Middle East geopolitical concerns add to market uncertainty.
Ethereum Foundation Sells ETH: Ethereum Foundation sold 2,000 ETH ($4M), converting to stablecoins.
